items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated turnover Rs 132.6 cr, up 22% YoY; operating revenue up 31.5% YoY
items.quote: On a quarter on quarter basis, we clocked a turnover of 132.6 crores as against 108.7 crores last year, same quarter, which is a growth of close to 22%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA Rs 32.19 cr, up 18% YoY; margin 24.3%
items.quote: EBITDA has grown from 27.29%, which was 25.11%, to 32.19 crores, which is a growth of close to 18% on an absolute basis.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated PBT Rs 16.82 cr, up 50% YoY; margin 12.68%
items.quote: PBT has grown from 11.26 crores, which was 10.36%, to 16.82 crores, which is 12.68%, which is a growth of close to 50%.

items.statement: BMW SOP final approval scheduled 24 Oct 2026; conditional shipping and pilot supplies already started
items.quote: level one approval is already done, and conditional shipping have already started, and the final approval, I think, now probably is 24th October.

items.statement: ZF project utilization at 50-60%; peak revenue shifted to 2030; new electric power steering project for US OEM via ZF on track for commercial supplies late 2027/mid 2028
items.quote: We are working at 50% to 60% utilization of the installed capacity. The peak year of ZF revenue for this specific project initially was 2028, but since that couple of years went away, they shifted to 2030 now.

items.statement: Energy crisis since March 2026 impacting operations; mitigating via new electric heat treatment plant replacing 30+ year old LPG furnaces
items.quote: despite all the challenges of severe energy crises which happened. It started from March 2026 and extended even now energy crisis. India is still not energy crisis free.

items.statement: FY27 capex of Rs 77 crore (Rs 35-40 crore for heat treatment replacement, Rs 35 crore for capacity expansion); next year's capex to be announced in January.
items.quote: We are investing what 77 crores of rupees of investment out of is of course it's going 35 to 40 crores for heat treatment replacement and remaining 35 crores is going for the capital expansion.

items.statement: Capex for FY28 and beyond will be announced annually; capacity additions from current capex to materialize partly in FY27 and FY28.
items.quote: This expansion eventually is going to be coming into force, partly maybe in 2026-27, partly 27-28.

items.statement: Project Venus (electric sports car) on track; Level 1 approval granted, final approval expected 24 Oct; pilot suppliers already shipping parts.
items.quote: This project is going very well as per track and on level one approval has already been granted and final approval is that day is coming precisely on 24th October.

items.statement: KTM volumes recovered to respectable levels; forecast for coming months very good; new Duke 790 launched with positive US market reception.
items.quote: KTM is already doing very good and they have reached very, very good respectable volumes and forecast of the coming months is very, very good.

items.statement: Export business follows sole-source model per component for product life; domestic customers (e.g., Royal Enfield) use multi-supplier strategy.
items.quote: This is beauty of our export business. Keep aside BMW, any export business, wherever we are there, if we are supplying a component, that component, we will remain sole supplier until there is a end of life of that product.

items.statement: Expects to reach 40-45 propulsion systems per month by January 2027
items.quote: I think by the time we will reach January, you will see the scale-up, completed in the sense that we should reach something like 40, 45 propulsion systems, local propulsion systems per month, to that capacity.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 1,000+ crore including 564 loco propulsion systems (INR 989 crore) and EMU order (INR 86 crore)
items.quote: Currently, as I mentioned, that we stand on the order book of about 1,000 plus crores.

items.statement: Expects 10%+ PAT margin at steady-state run rate; initial months may be lower due to scale-up
items.quote: We see about 10% plus PAT margin comfortably coming in from this order.

items.statement: IPO proceeds deployed for working capital to scale propulsion manufacturing; factories and manpower ready
items.quote: The only deficiency was working capital. That is well in place now and the orders are placed on, we, already mentioned, before the IPO in our various conferences that we are an R&D-oriented company.

items.statement: Targeting 10 propulsion systems in September, 25 in November, 40 in January, then consistent 40/month run-rate
items.quote: We will supply first 10 propulsion, I mean, 10 propulsion system in the month of September. We will scale it up in November to 25. We'll scale it up to 40 numbers, in the month of January and will remain consistently supplying about 40 propulsion system odd, every month, month-over-month.

items.statement: Expecting PAT margin above 10% once monthly run-rate of 40 propulsion systems is reached
items.quote: Initially, the margins were very constrained, or I would say negative margins because the quantities are very low. But the moment we reach this figure, I think we are expecting a PAT of more than 10% easily. From this revenues.

items.statement: No further capex on machinery or production; only test setups ordered, installation in 45-60 days
items.quote: No capex required on machinery, production, etc etera. Only capex required will be the testing machines or test setups. And, I think we have already ordered three more test setups so that we can test more number of propulsion system and supply faster. And hopefully we'll be completing the installations in next 45 days'

items.statement: Indian Railways splits tenders among multiple winners (7 winners last tender) to ensure supplier viability; L1 not sole winner
items.quote: Very right. First of all, L1 bidder will always be the winner, but as far as propulsion is goes, Indian Railways keep everybody in business. Do you know that last time when we bidded in the tender, there were 7 winners in that? And even all 7 were given, given small quantities because it is very difficult to build a ca

items.statement: Silicon carbide development targeted first on auxiliary converter, then traction; device still expensive and under development globally
items.quote: Second thing you asked me, the silicon carbide. Since the train speed is the major concern right now, so if you can reduce the size and the weight of the converter inverter systems then it will be helpful because more lighter, then you can go at higher speed easily. So first we are targeting with the auxiliary converte

items.statement: Run-rate EBITDA guidance: INR 2,700-2,750 crore by FY27 (4 GW capacity) and INR 4,500 crore by FY28 (6 GW capacity)
items.quote: So by FY27, again, we will be looking at capacity which will be close to, 4 gigawatts . So we add another 2 gigawatts that we mentioned. The run rate EBITDA for that capacity sits at around INR 2,700 crores, 2,750.

items.statement: Total capex INR 16,000 crore as of June 2026, expected to reach INR 22,000 crore by March 2027 including 3,900 MW commissioning and CWIP
items.quote: So as on 30th June, our total Capex is around INR 16,000 crores. If we will say by March’27 this amount will increase to around INR 22,000 crores, which includes the capacity of around 3,900, which is getting commissioned by March '27 and CWIP for the capacity which will be coming in the subsequent quarters.

items.statement: Shifting from wind-solar-battery to solar-battery as BESS costs fall below $100/kWh; solar+battery now matches returns with easier execution
items.quote: At that number we believe a solar plus battery solution is as good as a solar plus wind plus battery solution. Now given the fact that solar plus battery is then easier to execute while not losing out on the returns, it makes common sense logic.

items.statement: IPO raised INR 1,800 crore primary; net worth increased from INR 3,463 crore to INR 5,200 crore; net debt-to-equity improved from 3.24x
items.quote: We have raised INR 1,800 crores primary, through the IPO. With that, our now net worth has increased to INR 5,200 crores, which has meaningfully strengthened our balance sheet.

items.statement: LOA to PPA conversion: targeting >2 GW peak + ~4 GWh BESS in next few months (350 MW FDRE + 150 MW hybrid + 1 GW thermal mimic)
items.quote: So overall, I think if you combine everything, this will be almost more than 2 gigawatts of peak capacity plus around 4 gigawatt-hours of BESS capacity. That is something that we are looking at doing in the next few months.

items.statement: Merchant BESS: 1.5 GWh firm merchant capacity by June 2027; additional capacities to run merchant 9-12 months until GNA availability
items.quote: So 1.5 gigawatt hour is firm capacity which will run as merchant. I think there will be further capacities which will come in of the 4.5 gigawatt hour and then from 4.5 gigawatt hour to 10 gigawatt hour which we start putting up in the following year, right, which will come in as merchant.

items.statement: Aims to increase collection centers per lab from 24 to 35 in next couple of years.
items.quote: We plan to take this ratio from 1:24 to 1:35.

items.statement: Plans to add 100 mini hubs in next couple of years, 50 upgrades and 50 new.
items.quote: we'll come up with about 100 labs in the next couple of years -- 100 mini hubs in the next couple of years and of the 100 that we are talking about, about 50 of them are upgrading the existing centers

items.statement: Targets TruHealth share of revenue to increase from 18% to 25%.
items.quote: TruHealth, the wellness portfolio, the package portfolio, and that now from 18% needs to move to a 25%

items.statement: Aims to grow specialty business disproportionately to overall company growth.
items.quote: specialty business today is 40%. We would definitely like to keep growing this disproportionate to the overall growth of the company

items.statement: Plans to expand owned centers from 700-800 to 1,000 in next couple of years.
items.quote: the 700-800 centers that we have, which may expand to maybe 1,000 centers in the next couple of years

items.statement: Expects Core Diagnostics margin to improve to 20-25% in 3-4 years.
items.quote: we have the ability to turn it around and bring it to a 20%-25% margin in three to four years.

items.statement: Annual price increases of 2-3% plus product mix benefit.
items.quote: We do some price increase. We were doing it every year for about 2%-3% and of course, there was a revenue per patient increase that happens out of the product mix change.

items.statement: B2C revenue grew 18% in last quarter; B2B grew 15%.
items.quote: B2C is roughly 57% of the revenue share of the company, and that also is at a very good growth in the last quarter, it was around 18% growth.

items.statement: Digital channels contribute 25% of business; home collection 11-12% of revenues.
items.quote: Today, 25% of my business actually come from digital initiatives

items.statement: Productivity per employee increased 15% last year.
items.quote: we've been working a lot on productivity per employee as well, which was up by about 15% last year.

items.statement: Genomics business grew 2x in last year.
items.quote: We have seen that there is 2 times growth in genomics in last 1 year.

items.statement: Dividend payout was 22% of PAT last year.
items.quote: Last year we did a dividend of about 22% of PAT.

items.statement: Medium-term revenue growth guidance of 14-15%, excluding price increases and acquisitions.
items.quote: we mentioned that for the medium term we are talking about a 14 to 15 percentage guidance.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target of 27-28% over next 2-3 years, up from 24.4%.
items.quote: the ambition is to improve our EBITDA margin from 24.4% to 27 % to 28%

items.statement: Radiology mini-hub capex of INR35-40 lakhs per center; plan to set up 50 centers in year 1.
items.quote: roughly about INR35 lakhs-INR40 lakhs per investment would be good enough for us to run a good mini, you know, hubs, you know, to start with.

items.statement: Plan to add 250-300 collection centers per quarter, with potential to accelerate.
items.quote: there is a regular addition of 250 to 300 centers every quarter.

items.statement: Aspiration to reduce working capital days from double-digit to single-digit.
items.quote: our aspiration is to take our working capital to a single digit from currently the double-digit working capital.

items.statement: Home collection services growing 40%+ quarterly, currently contributing 25% of revenue.
items.quote: now contributing 25 %-odd and that is really growing almost 40% plus on every quarter.

items.statement: B2C-B2B mix currently 60-40, expected to remain around this level with B2C growing faster.
items.quote: currently it is 60 -40, 59-41 to be precise.

items.statement: North India revenue contribution expected to increase from 18% to 25% in next few years.
items.quote: the contribution will move probably from 18% to 25% in the next few years.

items.statement: International business contributes less than 10% of revenue; will continue to intensify India business.
items.quote: Less than 10% at this point.

items.statement: Franchisee centers account for 750-800 of 5,000 total centers; own centers in top 6-7 towns.
items.quote: Out of the 5,000 centers that we have currently, close to 750 -800 are our own centers and rest all are franchisee centers, right?

items.statement: Insta60 home collection service launched in Mumbai and Chennai, may expand to 8-9 cities.
items.quote: Insta360 is currently done in Mumbai and in Chennai, and this is done through the home visit channel largely, you know, because we have dedicated home visit, phlebotomists visiting, and there is dedicated resourcing and program there

items.statement: No capital from India to international operations; they are self-funding and self-sustainable.
items.quote: there is no capital that's been flowing from the Indian operations to international operation to build business there.

items.statement: Acquisitions will continue as a key growth lever, focusing on clean businesses with good credibility.
items.quote: acquisition will continue to a big, you know, lever for growth for us going forward

items.statement: Core Diagnostics turned around to high single-digit EBITDA one year after acquisition; targeting company-level EBITDA by year 3.
items.quote: 1 year after acquisition, t his is high single -digit EBITDA and we are now , I was guiding everyone that, maybe year 3 we will be close to the company levels of EBITDA.

items.statement: FY27 growth guidance raised to potentially over 60% year-on-year, up from initial 30-40%.
items.quote: So, the guidance initially given was 30% to 40% year-on-year. We believe the order book is streaming up well, and there is a potential in northwards of 60% for the current year now.

items.statement: Targets INR1,000 crores top line by FY29, fully capitalized to achieve it.
items.quote: We are fully capitalized to achieve our turnover of a top line of INR1,000 crores, which is in the near future.

items.statement: Undergoing ~INR1,000 crores capex over next 1.5 years across dredging, green vessels, shipyard.
items.quote: So currently, we are undergoing a capex of close to INR1,000 crores, which will be between now and within the next 1.5 years.

items.statement: Capex split: ~INR250 crores green tugs/vessels, ~INR450 crores dredging, balance shipyard/shipbuilding.
items.quote: So approximately INR250 crores is going into the construction of Green Tugs and green vessels, close to INR450 crores will be in the dredging business and the balance will be in the creation of the shipyard and the shipbuilding business.

items.statement: Balance order book over INR1,300 crores: ~INR240 crores dredging, ~INR850 crores charter, ~INR240 crores shipbuilding.
items.quote: Our detailed order book schedule reflects a balance order book of more than INR1,300 crores, comprising approximately INR240 crores towards dredging, INR850 crores towards charter and hire and INR240 crores in shipbuilding.

items.statement: Bid pipeline ~INR3,500+ crores: dredging INR1,200+ crores, charter INR1,100+ crores, shipbuilding INR1,400+ crores.
items.quote: Looking beyond the existing order book, our current bid pipeline is approximately INR3,500-plus crores, dredging stands at INR1,200-plus crores, charter and hire stands at INR1,100-plus crores and shipbuilding stands at INR1,400-plus crores.

items.statement: Won INR62.40 crores IWAI contract for 10 hybrid electric passenger ferries, ~10-month execution.
items.quote: The contract is valued at INR62.40 crores and has an execution tenure of approximately 10 months.

items.statement: Guides EBITDA margins 35-40%; dredging margins to expand with volume, not stay at Q1's 63%.
items.quote: It will not be the same as 63% operating margin. It is not the guidance, we've always guided between 35% to 40%. But with volumes in terms of dredging, the operating margin numbers are going to expand.

items.statement: In 2-3 years expects dredging 45-50%, shipbuilding 40-45%, chartering 5% of revenue.
items.quote: 2 to 3 years from now, we believe that dredging will contribute between 45% to 50% of the revenue mix. Shipbuilding will be between 40% to 45%, and the chartering business will be at 5%.

items.statement: Shipbuilding to scale significantly from Q4 FY27 with Saphale Phase 1 commissioning; yard to deliver 14 vessels Phase I, 18 full.
items.quote: We expect this business to scale significantly from quarter 4 of FY27, supported by new order inflows and the commissioning of Phase 1 of our Saphale shipyard.

items.statement: Raised INR150 crores preferential issue from institutional investors; INR100 crores block deal with SBI Funds.
items.quote: During the period, we also strengthened our capital base through INR150 crores preferential issue, which saw participation from marquee institutional investors, including 360 ONE PIPE Fund, FLC Investco LLC and Bank of India Mutual Fund.

items.statement: Green Tug business has 75% EBITDA margin under 15-year long-term contracts.
items.quote: So we have EBITDA margin of 75% in the Green Tug business. And those are all long-term contracts of 15 years.

items.statement: Business is project-driven; revenue and profitability can vary between quarters based on project mix and complexity.
items.quote: Further, our business is project driven. Revenue recognition and profitability can therefore vary between quarters depending upon the nature of the projects under execution, asset deployment, project mix and the technical complexity of the work performed.

items.statement: Bank remains on track to meet FY27 guidance and deliver strong performance.
items.quote: We remain on track to meet our FY27 guidance.

items.statement: Well capitalized and committed to FY27 growth plans; capital raise delay would not affect FY27 performance.
items.quote: We remain well capitalized and committed to our growth plans for FY27.

items.statement: Succession search expedited; names to be submitted to RBI in 3-4 months.
items.quote: No, I think in 3 to 4 months, we'll be able to submit the names to the RBI.

items.statement: Festive season looks promising, backed by capacity additions and robust domestic economic performance.
items.quote: As we look ahead, the festive season looks promising, backed by our capacity additions supported by robust domestic economic performance.

items.statement: Asset quality trends in secured and unsecured businesses tracked better or in line with Q1; no El Nino impact seen.
items.quote: Asset quality trends both on secured and unsecured businesses have tracked better or in line with the Q1 performance.

items.statement: Secured book share has grown past 50%; diversification strategy well on trajectory.
items.quote: Our strategic priority of diversifying the loan book has re sulted in the secured book share growing past 50%.

items.statement: Q1 loan book growth about 29% YoY with GNPA at 2.2%.
items.quote: Q1 loan book growth of approximately 29% year -on- year with GNPA at 2.2% is testament to our continued execution.

items.statement: CASA book grew 38% YoY; overall cost of funds at 6.9% for Q1.
items.quote: Even though the market has been under a lot of pressure on the deposits front, the bank has been able to grow the CASA book at a healthy 38% year -on-year with overall cost of funds at 6.9% for Q1.

items.statement: MSME growth proceeding as planned for the financial year; more details at Q2 earnings call.
items.quote: We also on the MSME front, we are going as per what we have planne d ourselves for this financial year.

items.statement: No material factor behind CEO exit apart from health; no issue with business strategies or bank working.
items.quote: I think it is his personal call. But absolutely, there is no issue with regard to the business strategies or the working of the bank.

items.statement: Board will keep in mind more robust succession planning for future eventualities.
items.quote: we will definitely keep it in mind in future to really have a more robust succession planning in such eventualities.

items.statement: Internal candidates will be considered for MD role; Carol has expressed interest.
items.quote: We will definitely consider internal candidates. I'm sure Carol is very serious candidate now.

items.statement: Will be more aggressive on trade and influencer spends in Q2 to widen top-line growth gap over industry.
items.quote: So we shall be even more aggressive in Q2 with respect to our spends on trade and influencer engagement in an attempt to further widen the gap between our top line growth and that of the industry.

items.statement: No significant capex requirements anticipated for the next 3 years as investment cycle ends.
items.quote: Now with this water-based Jodhpur facility being commissioned, our principal capex investment cycle draws to a close. We do not anticipate any significant capex requirements for the next 3 years.

items.statement: No concrete Q2 margin guidance; advises viewing margins over 6-month period due to RM volatility.
items.quote: But in light of that, I would not make any concrete prediction as far as Q2 margins are concerned.

items.statement: Gross margin may decline slightly if more spent on trade/influencers; EBITDA may fall ~1pp or rise 0.5pp.
items.quote: Maybe the EBITDA margin goes down a little bit by 1 percentage point, maybe it rises.

items.statement: Launching in-house two-pack polyurethane wood coating products in September-October in phases.
items.quote: And we expect to launch these products in the market during September and October in a phased manner.

items.statement: July was a very good month; top-line growth maintained or slightly better than Q1.
items.quote: July has been actually a very good month for us. So our top line growth has maintained its momentum or maybe gone a little better than Q1.

items.statement: Apple Chemie gross margins expected to improve through Q2 and return to normal by Q3.
items.quote: As the high-cost inventory is consumed, we expect gross margins of Apple Chemie to improve through the second quarter and return to its normal level by Q3.

items.statement: Proposes to acquire further 11% stake in Apple Chemie, raising aggregate holding to 62%.
items.quote: And as an expression of our confidence in this business, we propose to acquire a further 11% stake as per our terms of original agreement, taking Indigo Paints' aggregate holding in Apple Chemie up to 62%.

items.statement: Jodhpur water-based plant trial production to start in second half of August, ahead of festive season.
items.quote: Coming to capacity, our water -based facility at Jodhpur with an annual capacity of 90,000 kiloliters per annum is in the final stages of commissioning, and we expect to start trial production in the second half of August itself, comfortably ahead of the festive season.

items.statement: Declines concrete growth guidance; expects substantial gap over industry, wider each quarter.
items.quote: I would hesitate to give a very concrete number guidance on where exactly that growth number will stabilize.

items.statement: Differentiated products at ~29% of revenue; expects to maintain 28-30% band, not reach 35%.
items.quote: And their share of our revenue is about 29%, and it kind of maintains itself between 29% and 30% with growth.

items.statement: Raw material prices remain elevated and volatile; monitoring closely, no price cuts now.
items.quote: The raw material costs have eased since then, but remain elevated and volatile, and we are monitoring the situation quite closely.

items.statement: Demand back to near-normal growth conditions; expects to grow faster than industry.
items.quote: So as far as the demand is concerned, I think now we are reasonably comfortable that demand is back to near normal growth conditions.

items.statement: Expects 20%+ year-on-year revenue growth, with Middle East business over and above India growth.
items.quote: the guidance that we have given is that quarter-on-quarter, we will be clearly going ahead 20% plus growth as far as our revenues are concerned.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to hover around 47% to 56% for next couple of quarters.
items.quote: But one thing I can very clearly tell you that it will hover around 47% to 56% margin for next couple of quarters.

items.statement: Says 100 to 200 bps EBITDA margin improvement can be added.
items.quote: So, we very clearly say that 100 to 200 bps on EBITDA margin can be added.

items.statement: Middle East revenue expected at INR150-200 crores three years down the line.
items.quote: See, three years down the line, we believe that it should be somewhere to the tune of INR150 crores to INR200 crores.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex was INR76 crores versus INR110 crores last year, going slow due to Middle East turmoil and raw material inflation.
items.quote: But this year, first quarter, we have only spent INR76 crores.

items.statement: Takes 5% to 9% price increase every year based on wood price index; can beat inflation for next couple of years.
items.quote: As we have demonstrated in the past that we take nearly 5% to 9% price increase every year, and this is based on the wood price index which is listed on German Stock Exchange, for next couple of years, we could easily beat the inflation with price increase.

items.statement: Signed 48 new customers from 11 sectors in Q1, giving additional 100,000 pallet opportunity this financial year.
items.quote: We signed 48 new customers from 11 sectors, which is considerably higher than the normal customer acquisition rate.

items.statement: E-commerce and consumer goods demand expected to continue rising in Q2 and Q3 with festive season.
items.quote: The e-commerce and consumer goods demand, I believe, will continue to rise in quarter 2 and quarter 3 with upcoming Big Billion Day, Ganpati, Durga Puja, Diwali, and all the festive season.

items.statement: Movement Hire pallet movements increased 8% to 766,000 pallets this year.

items.statement: MHE business TARON added 174 new machines in Q1, revenue INR35.3 crores with 33% growth.
items.quote: In MHE business, TARON has added 174 new machines in the first quarter, and we did a revenue of INR35.3 crores with 33% growth over last year.

items.statement: Transportation cost reduced from 11% to 10% of revenue; repair cost reduced from 6% to 4.7%.
items.quote: our transportation cost as percentage per revenue has reduced from 11% to 10%, and our repair cost has reduced from 6% to 4.7%.

items.statement: Going slow on container asset acquisition as raw material cost doubled, hurting ROCE.
items.quote: If I am getting a crate for INR650, now it is costing INR1,200, INR1,000. My entire ROCE goes for a toss if I acquire new assets.

items.statement: Asset utilization expected to cross 90% to 91% in coming quarter and 92%+ in next couple of years.
items.quote: we expect in a quarter to come, we will cross this 90% to 91%, and next couple of years' time, it may go up to 92% plus also.

items.statement: Textile performance subdued in Q1 due to supply shortages from war and increased costs.
items.quote: the performance in textile was subdued on account of supply shortages due to the war, and the cost has also increased, so there had been a subdued performance in textiles in the first quarter.

items.statement: Plans net addition of about 850,000 pallets to pool this financial year.
items.quote: This is the same target that we have taken, that we will be adding somewhere round about 850,000 pallets net addition into this financial year.

items.statement: Full-year pallet pooling target of 3.7 million pallets, adding 800,000-900,000 pallets.
items.quote: We absolutely believe that the numbers that we have put in for the entire year, which is 3.7 million pallets, we will add round about 800,000 pallets to 900,000 pallets into our pooling model.

items.statement: Market guidance is 20% growth; management trying to outperform.
items.quote: But yes, the guidance that we have given to the market is 20%, but we are trying our level best to absolutely outperform and give great create great value for the shareholders.

items.statement: Took 5-6% price increase versus last year; per pallet yield rose to INR1.54.
items.quote: As far as the price increase is concerned, we have taken a 5% to 6% price increase as compared to last year.

items.statement: Per pallet yield improved to INR1.54 from INR1.45 a year ago.
items.quote: What you need to understand is that last year, same quarter, we were at a per pallet yield of INR1.45, and this quarter, we are at a per pallet yield of INR1.54.

items.statement: Price increases are built into 3-5 year contracts, indexed to wood prices.
items.quote: Price increase we definitely take, and all the agreements that we have is a 3-year to 5-year contract, and this pricing is -- price increase is already mentioned in that.

items.statement: EBITDA margin has ranged 47-56% over last six years; mix to stay same.
items.quote: And always, Aagam, since last six years, you look at our numbers, it is between 47% to 56%.

items.statement: EBITDA margins can fluctuate with business mix; absolute EBITDA value to rise.
items.quote: We cannot put a mathematical calculation that if you are growing by 24%, 25%, our value in EBITDA will definitely increase, but our margins can be, say, 50%, 51%, but the value will go up.

items.statement: Automotive share of turnover rose to 20% post-CHEP; internal target 22-25%.
items.quote: Now, this has gone to 20%. And we have given targets internally to actually take it to 22% to 25%.

items.statement: TARON business to remain within 14-17% of mix despite fast growth.
items.quote: TARON will always remain within a bracket of 14% to 17%, even though it is growing very fast.

items.statement: Movement Hire rose 8% YoY to 766,000 pallets, below overall 21% revenue growth.
items.quote: See, Movement Hire, as I have told that last year, we moved round about 711,000 pallet, and this year, we have moved 766,000 pallet, which is basically an 8% increase into as quarter-on-quarter, even though we have grown by 21% on our overall revenue.

items.statement: Signed 48 new customers in Q1, adding 120,000 Static Hire pool.
items.quote: So, if you look at that in this first quarter, we have signed round about 48 new customers, like Lear Automotive, Minda Instruments, Havells Logistics, Woodpecker, Green Agri, Sriram Foods.

items.statement: Deployed INR25 crores less in assets YoY; repairing more, purchasing fewer pallets.
items.quote: I would like to bring you to the point that as compared to last year, we have done INR25 crores less deployment in assets.

items.statement: Expects H2 to add INR150-200 crore revenue; similar growth and margins going forward.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 performance income INR29.7 crores: INR13 crores carry from Fund II, INR17 crores sponsor gains from Fund III and IV.

items.quote: In Tuticorin, we are in the DPR stage only. But there also, we expect a turnover of around -- should start with around INR 650 crores to INR 700 crores to scale up to around INR 1,800 crores to INR 2,000 crores over a period of next 7 to 8 years.

items.quote: the growth, I would say, for the new age industry or the new kind of products would be much faster, and we expect this to be in a double-digit number or maybe in the high 20s or 30s in the next few years, next maybe 2 years-3 years.

items.statement: EDGE series pyrometers co-developed with Micro-Epsilon to start dispatches in Q3 FY27.

items.statement: Medium-voltage heaters targeting explosion-proof certification by Q4 FY27.
items.quote: So, these heaters have already been tested up to 7.2 kilowatts and we're targeting explosion-proof certification by Q4 FY27.

But these kind of OEM players, so they have a much larger visibility. So, there the order cycle, like visibility could be maybe for 9 to 12 months' visibility is there.

items.statement: Raw materials booked at order receipt; price fluctuations passed through to customers.

items.statement: No negative revenue impact expected next quarters from geopolitical situation; mid-term positive.

items.statement: Expects volume growth trend to continue in Q2 FY27.

items.statement: Pharma, textiles, automotive, and consumer electronics are growing sectors.

items.statement: ASAP tech platform to launch in 30-60 days.
items.quote: So we are very hopeful that in the next 30 to 60 days, we should be able to launch the platform.
